assets.name: scene-gate-autumn-v2
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-bleed landscape illustration for a polished Japanese travel-journal web application, no UI. Style: sophisticated editorial gouache and watercolor, finely observed architectural forms, tactile paper grain, restrained hand-painted detail, atmospheric depth, luminous water, mature and calm rather than childish. Palette: warm ivory, deep ink teal, sage green, muted vermilion accents and natural golden light. Format: landscape 3:2, composition readable also when center-cropped to square on mobile cards, main subject within central 65 percent. Setting is a fictional Japanese coastal canal city; not a depiction of historical Heijo-kyo or Nara. No text, no labels, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no border, no UI, no crowds. Avoid flat geometric clipart, plasticky 3D, generic vector blobs, exaggerated fantasy architecture.
Primary request: A traditional working wooden canal sluice gate on a stone-lined waterway in autumn. One handsome dark timber overhead frame, brass hand wheel above center, visible vertical lifting mechanism and broad wooden sluice doors, clear flowing teal water and small cascades beneath, stone towpath, distant tiled-roof townhouses. Amber and vermilion maple branches frame the upper corners. Three-quarter eye-level view with canal leading from foreground to the gate in the middle distance. Crisp believable construction, tranquil afternoon light.
